title: Cross-validated choice of the bandwidth constant — cv_bandwidth
text: Chooses constant \(\kappa\) ratio bandwidth \(h = \kappa\,\hat\sigma_A n^{-1/6}\) \(F\)-fold cross-validation subjects, using criterion proposed supplementary material Hu et al. visit gap \(v\) fixed age \(u\), population minimizer \(r\) \(E[Y(u - v) r^2 - 2 Y(u) r \mid dN(u) = 1]\) ratio \(r(u, u - v) = f(u)/f(u - v)\). criterion --sample version loss, $$CV(\kappa) = \frac{1}{F}\sum_{j=1}^{F} \frac{1}{n_j} \sum_{\I_j}   \sum_{v} \int_{\tau_0 + v}^{\tau_1} \left[ Y_i(u - v)\{\hat r^{(-j)}(u, u - v)\}^2   - 2 Y_i(u)\, \hat r^{(-j)}(u, u - v) \right] dN_i^{(v)}(u),$$ \(\hat r^{(-j)}\) ratio estimator computed without fold \(j\), bandwidth \(\kappa\,\hat\sigma_{} n_{-j}^{-1/6}\), sum \(v\) runs distinct visit gaps (single term equally spaced visits), integral sum observed visits test subjects whose preceding visit lies \(v\) earlier. criterion involves ratio estimators therefore free penalty \(\lambda\) penalized estimator. Test points training ratio undefined (possible small constants) dropped; number reported n_dropped column table. flat criterion means data hardly discriminate bandwidths; advisable check sensitivity conclusions \(\kappa\).
